idea-plugin.name: PII-in-Logs Lint
idea-plugin.description:
22 rules that name the lines where a Node or TypeScript service writes personal data into logs, crash reports and analytics — with the article it touches and the one-line fix.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → PII-in-Logs Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 22 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/log-pii-telemetry-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/log-pii-telemetry-lint

action.description: Run PII-in-Logs Lint on the file in the editor
